description: This file defines a Next.js React component for the application's homepage. It fetches recent post data from an API endpoint, manages server-side rendering, supports suspense fallback UI during data loading, and renders a grid of posts with a header.

methods.name: fetchPosts
methods.description: Asynchronous function that constructs an API URL based on environment variables, fetches post data, and returns it in a structured format.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Default async React component that fetches posts and renders the homepage, including a header and a posts grid within suspense fallback UI.
